summary: Plumas Bancorp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 merely announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.33 per common share declared by its board, payable August 17, 2026 to holders of record August 3, 2026. This is an ordinary dividend declaration with no acquisition, divestiture, activist involvement, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. Such routine dividend announcements do not constitute a special situation, so no category applies. The statement is straightforward and carries no event-driven investment implications.
